arabic text:
NOKEY SINA KAY UPAR KEHTA THA FARQE SARWAR
GHAR LOOT GAYAAA HEY MERA, MAARA GAYA BRADAR..
AMMA… AMMA GHARIB HOON MAIN,
AMMA GHARIB HOON MAIN
english translation text:
From the point of the spear, the severed head of the Master said:
My home has been plundered; my brother has been slain.
Mother… Mother, I am abandoned and alone,
Mother, I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
ASGHAR KAY KHOON SAY MAINEY DEKHO WAZU KIYA
HAI
IS IMTEHAA MAIN USNEY BHI SURQ RU KIYA HAI…
ISKI LAHAD BANAKAR AMMA GHARIB HOON MAIN,
english translation text:
See, Mother, I performed ablution with Asghar’s blood.
In this trial, he too emerged honoured and radiant.
After making his tiny grave,
Mother, I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
MAIN KIS KHADAR HOON PYAASA AMMA BATAOON
KYUNKAR
SOONKHA GALA THA ITNA, CHALTA NAHI THA KHANJAR
QABSAY MAIN RAKH KAY KAUSAR, AMMA GHARIB HOON
MAIN,
english translation text:
How can I tell you, Mother,
how desperately thirsty I am?
My throat was so dry that even the dagger would not move.
Keep Kawthar ready for me,
Mother; I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
MAIN KAISA BAAP THA JO AY DAUREY IMTIHANI
ROTI RAHI SAKINA MAIN DEY SAKA NA PAANI
AAYE YAQEEN NA KYUNKAR, AMMA GHARIB HOON
MAIN,
english translation text:
What kind of father was I in this hour of trial?
Sakina kept crying, yet I could not give her water.
How could you not believe it,
Mother? I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
BARCHI JAWAA PISAR KAY SEENEY SEY MAINEY
KHENCHI
ANSAR O AKHROBA KI, QASIM KI LAASH DEKHI.
IBNE AMIR HO KAR, AMMA GHARIB HOON MAIN,
english translation text:
With my own hands I pulled the spear from my young son’s chest.
I saw the bodies of my companions, my relatives, and Qasim.
Though I am the son of the Commander,
Mother, I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
GHODO KAY DODNEY SAY PAAMAL HO CHUKA HU
KYA AB BHI MAIN WAHI HO HAIRAAN HOON SOCHTA
HOON
NAAQA BANEY PAYAMBAR, AMMA GHARIB HOON MAIN,
english translation text:
I have been trampled beneath the galloping horses.
Am I still the same person? I wonder in bewilderment.
The Prophet was made to ride a camel;
Mother, I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
MAIN KIS KHADAR HOON PYAASA AMMA BATAOON
KYUNKAR
SOONKHA GALA THA ITNA, CHALTA NAHI THA KHANJAR
KHABSAY MAIN RAKH KAY KAUSAR, AMMA GHARIB
HOON MAIN,
english translation text:
How can I tell you, Mother,
how desperately thirsty I am?
My throat was so dry that even the dagger would not move.
Keep Kawthar ready for me,
Mother; I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
AAP AA GAYEE HAI AMMA, YAAD AA RAHA HAI
BACHPAN
WOH SAATH SAATH CHALNA, AUR APNAY GHAR KA
AANGAN
AB KHAAK KA HAI BISTAR, AMMA GHARIB HOON MAIN,
english translation text:
You have come to me, Mother,
and childhood returns to mind:
Walking beside you, and the courtyard of our home.
Now dust is my bedding;
Mother, I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
DIL GHAM SEY CHAAK BHI HAI, ZAKHMO MEY KHAAK
BHI HAI..
UDHTI HUEE NAZAR MEY KHAIMO KI RAAKH BHI HAI..
ZAINAB KA HAI KHULA SAR, AMMA GHARIB HOON
MAIN,
english translation text:
My heart is torn by grief,
and dust fills my wounds.
Before my eyes drifts the ash of the burned tents.
Zainab’s head is uncovered;
Mother, I am abandoned and alone.

arabic text:
REHAN PHAT NA JAAYE AHLEY AZAA KA SEENA
BUS ROK LEY YAHI PAR SHABBIR KA YE NAUHA
SAB RO RAHEY HAI SUNKAR, AMMA GHARIB HOON
MAIN,
english translation text:
Rehan, stop before the mourners’ hearts burst.
End Shabbir’s lament here.
All who hear it are weeping:
Mother, I am abandoned and alone.
